sources.entry: Multron Download Manager - Multi-connection download manager with yt-dlp and BitTorrent support. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A Rust-based desktop download manager with multi-connection HTTP downloads, yt-dlp video support, Google Drive/MEGA resolvers, and a built-in BitTorrent client.
summary.what_it_does: Multron Download Manager is a desktop app that downloads files by splitting each one into parallel byte ranges, 8 connections by default and adjustable up to 64, and writes them straight to their final offsets. It resumes interrupted downloads, checks ETags so changed files are not mixed, and handles retries and link renewal. Media downloads use yt-dlp for YouTube, Reddit, Instagram and many other sites, and share-link resolvers cover Google Drive, MEGA, Dropbox, MediaFire, Pixeldrain and GitHub. A built-in BitTorrent client (librqbit) handles magnet links and .torrent files, with seeding rules, queueing and a torrent search across configured sites. A companion browser extension for Chromium browsers and Firefox sends downloads to the app. The README also describes an optional SHA-256 verification step and a Multron Cloud malware scan that is marked as testing.
use_cases: download files from Google Drive or MEGA
torrent downloads with a desktop client
batch-download a list of numbered links
verify a file's SHA-256 after download
notable: Multi-connection engine with speed-based work stealing and direct-to-disk writes with no merge step
Built-in BitTorrent client with DHT, uTP, UPnP, IP filters and an RSS feed with auto-download rules
Browser extension that takes over browser downloads and can start the app when closed
Covers Windows, macOS and Linux with installers, portable Windows zip, and package manager entries
Available in 24 languages, with translations as plain .ini files
caveats: macOS builds are not notarized yet, so the first launch needs a right-click Open or an xattr command
Multron Cloud malware scanning is labeled as testing
Snap and Flatpak packages are listed as coming soon
Some features need extra setup, such as Flatpak browsers needing a manual flatpak override to start the app
Mandatory updates run at startup, and development builds never update themselves
